items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Baron Lee, and all these fellows. They began to take clowns and stand them in front of the band

ctx.x: And then, band conductors got obsolete -- musician band conductors. Because the fad comes in with Cab Calloway, Noble Sisle, and Sunshine Sammy and -- what was this fellow's name --
Baron Lee, and all these fellows. They began to take clowns and stand them in front of the band, you know what I mean?
